approval.scope: Plan and order approved on the basis of the Bot cycle 64 gap audit. Accepts no milestone, approves no deck.

milestone_effects.M5: stays unaccepted until saturation and A-F layers regenerate it

decisions.text: Adaptive saturation with tiered testing, not exhaustive paired testing. No fixed numeric discovery cap. Cheap screening may prioritize workload but must never be an absolute exclusion gate; candidates may escalate through dependency evidence, unusual Oracle interaction, new-card status, package gaps, human evidence, anomaly detection, or other justified signals.

Frozen retrospective corpus with contamination flags plus a genuinely prospective holdout for future cards, corrections and human decisions. Never claim the historical corpus is perfectly blind where prior ingestion makes that impossible.

Shared factual inputs, commit-then-reveal output blinding; neither sees the other's conclusions before both outputs are committed and hashed. Pass C (incumbent-defense critic) may see both. Reconciliation only afterward.
Bounded scripted proxies and deterministic perturbations approved, with explicit assumptions, sensitivity where appropriate, documented limitations. No unsupported multiplayer win-rate simulation.

Versioned post-M2 correction overlay plus a materiality gate. If a change does not alter commander role, dependency, ceiling, anti-goals, required packages or another material Blueprint conclusion, M2 is not reopened; if it does, targeted review/reopen for that deck. Regenerate downstream artifacts either way.

snap-20261016 frozen as the development snapshot during A-F. Immediately before final M5 acceptance and the Birthday baseline freeze, create a fresh Birthday authority snapshot (current Oracle/Scryfall, rules, legality, EDHREC, Spellbook, tournament evidence, new cards), delta refresh, regenerate every affected artifact. The Birthday snapshot is M6's authoritative start.
Build and freeze the H sampler/schema before M6 outputs exist.
